title: Can you solve the pirate riddle? - Alex Gendler
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】你能解開海盜之謎嗎？ - 亞歷克斯詹德勒（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: It's a good day to be a pirate.
cues.en: It's a good day to be a pirate.
cues.zh: 現在是做海盜的好時機

cues.text: Amaro and his four mateys, Bart, Charlotte, Daniel,
cues.en: Amaro and his four mateys, Bart, Charlotte, Daniel,
cues.zh: 現在是做海盜的好時機 阿馬羅和他四個夥伴 巴特 夏洛特 丹尼爾

cues.text: and Eliza have struck gold: a chest with 100 coins.
cues.en: and Eliza have struck gold: a chest with 100 coins.
cues.zh: 丹尼爾 和伊麗莎 碰上了大好事： 他們挖到一個裝著一百枚金幣的箱子

cues.text: But now, they must divvy up the booty according to the pirate code.
cues.en: But now, they must divvy up the booty according to the pirate code.
cues.zh: 他們挖到一個裝著一百枚金幣的箱子 但是現在，他們必須要遵守 海盜分金的分配規則

cues.text: As captain, Amaro gets to propose how to distribute the coins.
cues.en: As captain, Amaro gets to propose how to distribute the coins.
cues.zh: 但是現在，他們必須要遵守 海盜分金的分配規則 身為船長，阿馬羅 得以提出金幣的分配方案 然後每位海盜，包括阿馬羅本人

cues.text: Then, each pirate, including Amaro himself, gets to vote either yarr or nay.
cues.en: Then, each pirate, including Amaro himself, gets to vote either yarr or nay.
cues.zh: 然後每位海盜，包括阿馬羅本人 可以表決贊成或否決 如果表決透過或正反方平手， 就按照金幣分配方案進行

cues.text: If the vote passes, or if there's a tie, the coins are divided according to plan.
cues.en: If the vote passes, or if there's a tie, the coins are divided according to plan.
cues.zh: 如果表決透過或正反方平手， 就按照金幣分配方案進行 但是如果表決沒透過

cues.text: But if the majority votes nay, Amaro must walk the plank
cues.en: But if the majority votes nay, Amaro must walk the plank
cues.zh: 但是如果表決沒透過 阿馬羅將會被入大海餵鯊魚

cues.text: and Bart becomes captain.
cues.en: and Bart becomes captain.
cues.zh: 阿馬羅將會被入大海餵鯊魚 而巴特成為船長

cues.text: Then, Bart gets to propose a new distribution and all remaining pirates vote again.
cues.en: Then, Bart gets to propose a new distribution and all remaining pirates vote again.
cues.zh: 然後，巴特可以提出新的金幣分配方案 然後剩下的海盜可以再次表決 如果巴特的提案沒過半， 他也要被投入大海

cues.text: If his plan is rejected, he walks the plank, too, and Charlotte takes his place.
cues.en: If his plan is rejected, he walks the plank, too, and Charlotte takes his place.
cues.zh: 如果巴特的提案沒過半， 他也要被投入大海 而夏洛特就會取代他當船長 重覆這程式

cues.text: This process repeats, with the captain's hat moving to Daniel and then Eliza
cues.en: This process repeats, with the captain's hat moving to Daniel and then Eliza
cues.zh: 而夏洛特就會取代他當船長 重覆這程式 接著是丹尼爾，然後是伊麗莎當船長

cues.text: until either a proposal is accepted or there's only one pirate left.
cues.en: until either a proposal is accepted or there's only one pirate left.
cues.zh: 直到一個方案被接受或只剩一位海盜 當然， 每位海盜都想要活著 並且得到最大的利益

cues.text: Naturally, each pirate wants to stay alive while getting as much gold as possible.
cues.en: Naturally, each pirate wants to stay alive while getting as much gold as possible.
cues.zh: 當然， 每位海盜都想要活著 並且得到最大的利益 但身為海盜，他們不信任彼此

cues.text: But being pirates, none of them trust each other, so they can't collaborate in advance.
cues.en: But being pirates, none of them trust each other, so they can't collaborate in advance.
cues.zh: 但身為海盜，他們不信任彼此 所以他們無法事先溝通 他們又是殺人不眨眼的海盜

cues.text: And being blood-thirsty pirates, if anyone thinks they'll end up with the same amount of gold either way,
cues.en: And being blood-thirsty pirates, if anyone thinks they'll end up with the same amount of gold either way,
cues.zh: 他們又是殺人不眨眼的海盜 如果他們覺得表決後都還是 會拿一樣數量的金幣 他們就會故意惡整船長， 把他投入大海餵鯊魚

cues.text: they'll vote to make the captain walk the plank just for fun.
cues.en: they'll vote to make the captain walk the plank just for fun.
cues.zh: 他們就會故意惡整船長， 把他投入大海餵鯊魚 最後一點， 每位海盜都是 邏輯推論高手

cues.text: Finally, each pirate is excellent at logical deduction
cues.en: Finally, each pirate is excellent at logical deduction
cues.zh: 最後一點， 每位海盜都是 邏輯推論高手 也同時知道其他人也是

cues.text: and knows that the others are, too.
cues.en: and knows that the others are, too.
cues.zh: 也同時知道其他人也是 阿馬羅應該要如何提出分配規則 才能確保他的性命?

cues.text: What distribution should Amaro propose to make sure he lives?
cues.en: What distribution should Amaro propose to make sure he lives?
cues.zh: 阿馬羅應該要如何提出分配規則 才能確保他的性命? 按暫停如果想自己計算答案！

cues.text: Pause here if you want to figure it out for yourself!
cues.en: Pause here if you want to figure it out for yourself!
cues.zh: 按暫停如果想自己計算答案！ 解答 3 秒後會出現

cues.text: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1 If we follow our intuition,
cues.en: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1 If we follow our intuition,
cues.zh: 解答 3 秒後會出現 解答：再 2 秒 解答：再 1 秒 如果我們按照直覺考慮 阿馬羅似乎要把大多數的黃金 拿來賄賂其他海盜

cues.text: it seems like Amaro should try to bribe the other pirates with most of the gold
cues.en: it seems like Amaro should try to bribe the other pirates with most of the gold
cues.zh: 阿馬羅似乎要把大多數的黃金 拿來賄賂其他海盜 來增加他的方案被接受的機率

cues.text: to increase the chances of his plan being accepted.
cues.en: to increase the chances of his plan being accepted.
cues.zh: 來增加他的方案被接受的機率

cues.text: But it turns out he can do much better than that. Why?
cues.en: But it turns out he can do much better than that. Why?
cues.zh: 但其實他可以給自己留更多黃金。 為什麼呢？ 就像之前說的， 海盜都知道別人是邏輯高手

cues.text: Like we said, the pirates all know each other to be top-notch logicians.
cues.en: Like we said, the pirates all know each other to be top-notch logicians.
cues.zh: 就像之前說的， 海盜都知道別人是邏輯高手

cues.text: So when each votes, they won't just be thinking about the current proposal,
cues.en: So when each votes, they won't just be thinking about the current proposal,
cues.zh: 所以投票時他們不只會考慮當下的提案 也會考慮之後所有可能的情況

cues.text: but about all possible outcomes down the line.
cues.en: but about all possible outcomes down the line.
cues.zh: 也會考慮之後所有可能的情況 因為提案的排序已經事先知道

cues.text: And because the rank order is known in advance, each can accurately predict how the others would vote in any situation
cues.en: And because the rank order is known in advance, each can accurately predict how the others would vote in any situation
cues.zh: 因為提案的排序已經事先知道 每位都能預測其他人 在任何情況下會如何投票

cues.text: and adjust their own votes accordingly.
cues.en: and adjust their own votes accordingly.
cues.zh: 每位都能預測其他人 在任何情況下會如何投票 並且根據這些推論調整自己的選擇

cues.text: Because Eliza's last, she has the most outcomes to consider,
cues.en: Because Eliza's last, she has the most outcomes to consider,
cues.zh: 並且根據這些推論調整自己的選擇 因為伊麗莎排在最後，她的顧慮也最多 讓我們從分析她的思考程式開始

cues.text: so let's start by following her thought process.
cues.en: so let's start by following her thought process.
cues.zh: 讓我們從分析她的思考程式開始 她從最後的可能性情境往回推

cues.text: She'd reason this out by working backwards from the last possible scenario
cues.en: She'd reason this out by working backwards from the last possible scenario
cues.zh: 她從最後的可能性情境往回推 也就是隻剩丹尼爾和她

cues.text: with only her and Daniel remaining.
cues.en: with only her and Daniel remaining.
cues.zh: 也就是隻剩丹尼爾和她

cues.text: Daniel would obviously propose to keep all the gold
cues.en: Daniel would obviously propose to keep all the gold
cues.zh: 也就是隻剩丹尼爾和她 丹尼爾當然會提議自己擁有所有的寶藏 而伊麗莎的一票否決並不能推翻他的提案

cues.text: and Eliza's one vote would not be enough to override him,
cues.en: and Eliza's one vote would not be enough to override him,
cues.zh: 而伊麗莎的一票否決並不能推翻他的提案 所以伊麗莎會不惜一切代價避免這個狀況

cues.text: so Eliza wants to avoid this situation at all costs.
cues.en: so Eliza wants to avoid this situation at all costs.
cues.zh: 所以伊麗莎會不惜一切代價避免這個狀況

cues.text: Now we move to the previous decision point with three pirates left and Charlotte making the proposal.
cues.en: Now we move to the previous decision point with three pirates left and Charlotte making the proposal.
cues.zh: 所以伊麗莎會不惜一切代價避免這個狀況 現在我們先到前一個投票點 剩下三位海盜，且輪到夏洛特提案 大家都知道如果她被多數票否決， 決定權就給丹尼爾

cues.text: Everyone knows that if she's outvoted, the decision moves to Daniel,
cues.en: Everyone knows that if she's outvoted, the decision moves to Daniel,
cues.zh: 大家都知道如果她被多數票否決， 決定權就給丹尼爾 他就會拿到所有的黃金， 同時伊麗莎甚麼都沒有拿到

cues.text: who will then get all the gold while Eliza gets nothing.
cues.en: who will then get all the gold while Eliza gets nothing.
cues.zh: 他就會拿到所有的黃金， 同時伊麗莎甚麼都沒有拿到

cues.text: So to secure Eliza's vote, Charlotte only needs to offer her slightly more than nothing, one coin.
cues.en: So to secure Eliza's vote, Charlotte only needs to offer her slightly more than nothing, one coin.
cues.zh: 他就會拿到所有的黃金， 同時伊麗莎甚麼都沒有拿到 所以如果要保障伊麗莎的贊成 夏洛特只要給予微薄的利益， 甚至是一枚金幣 這樣就能保障她的支援

cues.text: Since this ensures her support, Charlotte doesn't need to offer Daniel anything at all.
cues.en: Since this ensures her support, Charlotte doesn't need to offer Daniel anything at all.
cues.zh: 這樣就能保障她的支援 夏洛特不需要分給丹尼爾任何黃金

cues.text: What if there are four pirates?
cues.en: What if there are four pirates?
cues.zh: 夏洛特不需要分給丹尼爾任何黃金 如果剩四位海盜呢？

cues.text: As captain, Bart would still only need one other vote for his plan to pass.
cues.en: As captain, Bart would still only need one other vote for his plan to pass.
cues.zh: 如果剩四位海盜呢？ 身為船長，巴特也只多需要 一票來讓他的提案透過

cues.text: He knows that Daniel wouldn't want the decision to pass to Charlotte,
cues.en: He knows that Daniel wouldn't want the decision to pass to Charlotte,
cues.zh: 身為船長，巴特也只多需要 一票來讓他的提案透過 他知道丹尼爾不會想要 讓提案權輪到夏洛特手上

cues.text: so he would offer Daniel one coin for his support
cues.en: so he would offer Daniel one coin for his support
cues.zh: 他知道丹尼爾不會想要 讓提案權輪到夏洛特手上 所以他會給丹尼爾一個金幣 以換取他的支援

cues.text: with nothing for Charlotte or Eliza.
cues.en: with nothing for Charlotte or Eliza.
cues.zh: 所以他會給丹尼爾一個金幣 以換取他的支援 而不分給夏洛特及伊麗莎任何東西

cues.text: Now we're back at the initial vote with all five pirates standing.
cues.en: Now we're back at the initial vote with all five pirates standing.
cues.zh: 而不分給夏洛特及伊麗莎任何東西 現在我們回到最初的表決， 而五位海盜都在

cues.text: Having considered all the other scenarios, Amaro knows that if he goes overboard,
cues.en: Having considered all the other scenarios, Amaro knows that if he goes overboard,
cues.zh: 現在我們回到最初的表決， 而五位海盜都在 考慮了所有其他情況 阿馬羅知道如果他落水

cues.text: the decision comes down to Bart, which would be bad news for Charlotte and Eliza.
cues.en: the decision comes down to Bart, which would be bad news for Charlotte and Eliza.
cues.zh: 阿馬羅知道如果他落水 巴特就會有提案權 將會對夏洛特和伊麗莎不利

cues.text: So he offers them one coin each, keeping 98 for himself.
cues.en: So he offers them one coin each, keeping 98 for himself.
cues.zh: 將會對夏洛特和伊麗莎不利 所以他發給她們每位一枚金幣， 給自己保留 98 枚金幣

cues.text: Bart and Daniel vote nay, but Charlotte and Eliza grudgingly vote yarr
cues.en: Bart and Daniel vote nay, but Charlotte and Eliza grudgingly vote yarr
cues.zh: 所以他發給她們每位一枚金幣， 給自己保留 98 枚金幣 巴特和丹尼爾會表示否決 但是夏洛特和伊麗莎勉強同意

cues.text: knowing that the alternative would be worse for them.
cues.en: knowing that the alternative would be worse for them.
cues.zh: 但是夏洛特和伊麗莎勉強同意 因為她們知道否決的替代方案 只會對他們更加不利

cues.text: The pirate game involves some interesting concepts from game theory.
cues.en: The pirate game involves some interesting concepts from game theory.
cues.zh: 因為她們知道否決的替代方案 只會對他們更加不利 海盜遊戲涉及一些有趣遊戲理論概念

cues.text: One is the concept of common knowledge where each person is aware of what the others know
cues.en: One is the concept of common knowledge where each person is aware of what the others know
cues.zh: 海盜遊戲涉及一些有趣遊戲理論概念 一個就是基本常識的概念 每個人都知道其他人所知道的

cues.text: and uses this to predict their reasoning.
cues.en: and uses this to predict their reasoning.
cues.zh: 每個人都知道其他人所知道的 並用它來預測他們的推理

cues.text: And the final distribution is an example of a Nash equilibrium
cues.en: And the final distribution is an example of a Nash equilibrium
cues.zh: 而最後的分配是個 「奈許均衡點」的例子 每個人都知道彼此的策略

cues.text: where each player knows every other players' strategy and chooses theirs accordingly.
cues.en: where each player knows every other players' strategy and chooses theirs accordingly.
cues.zh: 而最後的分配是個 「奈許均衡點」的例子 每個人都知道彼此的策略 並相應地做他們的選擇

cues.text: Even though it may lead to a worse outcome for everyone than cooperating would,
cues.en: Even though it may lead to a worse outcome for everyone than cooperating would,
cues.zh: 並相應地做他們的選擇 雖然有可能每個人得到的結果 比起合作更糟

cues.text: no individual player can benefit by changing their strategy.
cues.en: no individual player can benefit by changing their strategy.
cues.zh: 但沒有人因為改變策略而受益 所以看來阿馬羅保留了大部分的金幣

cues.text: So it looks like Amaro gets to keep most of the gold, and the other pirates might need to find better ways
cues.en: So it looks like Amaro gets to keep most of the gold, and the other pirates might need to find better ways
cues.zh: 所以看來阿馬羅保留了大部分的金幣 而其他海盜可能需要找更好的途徑 來使用他們優秀的邏輯

cues.text: to use those impressive logic skills, like revising this absurd pirate code.
cues.en: to use those impressive logic skills, like revising this absurd pirate code.
cues.zh: 來使用他們優秀的邏輯 例如修改這荒謬的海盜金錢分配規則
